import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def compute(data, lookback=252, vol_days=60, target_vol=0.40, **_):
    close = data["close_adj"]
    ret = close.pct_change()
    sigma = ret.rolling(vol_days).std() * np.sqrt(252.0)
    past = close / close.shift(lookback) - 1.0
    sigma = sigma.where(sigma > 0)
    return np.sign(past) * target_vol / sigma

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def _lag(df, days):
    """Calendar-day lag using only past observations (as-of lookup, no future data)."""
    idx = df.index
    out = df.reindex(idx - pd.Timedelta(days=days), method="ffill")
    out.index = idx
    return out


def compute(data, lag_days=365, **_):
    ni, cfo = data["net_income"], data["operating_cash_flow"]
    ta = data["total_assets"].where(data["total_assets"] > 0)
    rev = data["revenue"].where(data["revenue"] > 0)
    ca, cl = data["current_assets"], data["current_liabilities"].where(data["current_liabilities"] > 0)
    roa = ni / ta
    cfoa = cfo / ta
    lev = data["long_term_debt"] / ta
    liq = ca / cl
    margin = data["gross_profit"] / rev
    turn = rev / ta
    sh = data["shares_outstanding"]

    def flag(cond, *inputs):
        valid = inputs[0].notna()
        for x in inputs[1:]:
            valid = valid & x.notna()
        return cond.astype(float).where(valid)

    f1 = flag(roa > 0, roa)
    f2 = flag(cfo > 0, cfo)
    roa_p = _lag(roa, lag_days)
    f3 = flag(roa > roa_p, roa, roa_p)
    f4 = flag(cfoa > roa, cfoa, roa)
    lev_p = _lag(lev, lag_days)
    f5 = flag(lev < lev_p, lev, lev_p)
    liq_p = _lag(liq, lag_days)
    f6 = flag(liq > liq_p, liq, liq_p)
    sh_p = _lag(sh, lag_days)
    f7 = flag(sh <= sh_p, sh, sh_p)
    m_p = _lag(margin, lag_days)
    f8 = flag(margin > m_p, margin, m_p)
    t_p = _lag(turn, lag_days)
    f9 = flag(turn > t_p, turn, t_p)
    return f1 + f2 + f3 + f4 + f5 + f6 + f7 + f8 + f9

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def compute(data, window=21, **_):
    ret = data["close_adj"].pct_change()
    mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)
    var_m = mkt.rolling(window).var()
    var_i = ret.rolling(window).var()
    cov_im = ret.rolling(window).cov(mkt)
    resid_var = var_i - cov_im.pow(2).div(var_m.where(var_m > 0), axis=0)
    return np.sqrt(resid_var.clip(lower=0.0))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def compute(data, vol_window=252, corr_window=1260, shrink_w=0.6, **_):
    ret = data["close_adj"].pct_change()
    mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)
    sig_i = ret.rolling(vol_window).std()
    sig_m = mkt.rolling(vol_window).std()
    rho = ret.rolling(corr_window).corr(mkt)
    beta_ts = rho * sig_i.div(sig_m.where(sig_m > 0), axis=0)
    return shrink_w * beta_ts + (1.0 - shrink_w) * 1.0

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def compute(data, window=252, **_):
    ret = data["close_adj"].pct_change()
    mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)
    mu = mkt.rolling(window).mean()
    d = (mkt < mu).astype(float).where(mu.notna())
    n = d.rolling(window).sum()
    sx = (mkt * d).rolling(window).sum()
    sxx = (mkt * mkt * d).rolling(window).sum()
    sy = ret.mul(d, axis=0).rolling(window).sum()
    sxy = ret.mul(mkt * d, axis=0).rolling(window).sum()
    n = n.where(n > 2)
    mean_x = sx / n
    var_x = sxx / n - mean_x ** 2
    cov = sxy.div(n, axis=0) - sy.div(n, axis=0).mul(mean_x, axis=0)
    return cov.div(var_x.where(var_x > 0), axis=0)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def _lag(df, days):
    """Calendar-day lag using only past observations (as-of lookup, no future data)."""
    idx = df.index
    out = df.reindex(idx - pd.Timedelta(days=days), method="ffill")
    out.index = idx
    return out


def compute(data, lag_days=365, **_):
    mr = data["monthly_revenue"].where(data["monthly_revenue"] > 0)
    return mr / _lag(mr, lag_days) - 1.0

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def compute(data, short_days=91, long_days=365, **_):
    mr = data["monthly_revenue"].where(data["monthly_revenue"] > 0)
    short = mr.rolling("%dD" % short_days, min_periods=1).mean()
    long_ = mr.rolling("%dD" % long_days, min_periods=int(long_days * 0.4)).mean()
    return short / long_ - 1.0
